timeline.message: Remove unnecessary comments per team's suggestion

timeline.body: For Greenlake we had the practice of putting the scenario into the test name such as "GIVEN_a_service_in_new_WHEN_setState_to_installing_THEN_service_gets_installed" or whatever. We don't necessarily need to follow that, but I would at least suggest explaining what is Given, what is the When, and what is the Then in your comments. Just having the blocks doesn't explain enough.
